content:
infra-bot: Incident bot detected surge: 600+ alerts in 10m for svc/model-serving-rt. PagerDuty tickets being created. Root TS: 1729994321

sam_oncall: seeing the same — PD flooding. High noise, but I can't see a single customer-impacting error in logs. Anyone oncall to triage? :eyes:

anya_eng: i'm on. looking at the traces. most errors are 429 spikes from our fanout queue, downstream GPUs are throttling and causing retries -> alert storm.

leah_sre: quick ask: can we gate alerts to only critical for the next 15m while we stabilize? we should avoid PD fatigue. propose temporary routing: severity=critical -> PD, severity=warning -> channel only.

sam_oncall: +1 to gating. can someone push a temporary rule? I don't want to edit many Prom rules manually.

nora_prodops: i can set a temporary notification policy in PD for the service to squash low/sev tickets. will do a 15m squelch for alerts with tag:suppressed=auto-gate.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: maintenance window created for service=model-serving-rt, duration=15m, applied to escalation policy "model-serving-oncall". Open incidents will be suppressed if they match suppression rule.

mike_support: flagging customer comms: a couple of customers pinged support. i'm drafting a short blurb. If this looks like >15m, we'll need arms-length note.

anya_eng: While PD gating is up, i'm going to add a temporary dedupe on our alert router to collapse identical error signatures (http 429 + retry-after). plan: route only one alert per 60s per service-instance.

leah_sre: for auditability, post the commands you're running. also create a dashboard so we can watch unique signatures instead of total alerts.

anya_eng: putting commands here:

```
# add temporary dedupe policy (router)
infractl alert-router add-policy \
  --name temp-dedupe-429s \
  --match "service:model-serving-rt AND status:429" \
  --dedupe-window 60s \
  --tag suppressed=temp-dedupe

# revert in 15m
infractl alert-router note add --policy temp-dedupe-429s --expiry 15m
```

sam_oncall: running the infractl now. will post result.

infra-bot: infractl: policy "temp-dedupe-429s" created successfully (id: pd-rt-042).

anya_eng: created a quick prometheus rule change as well to raise noise threshold for the spike metric. snippet below, applied as configmap patch 1 of 1:

```
- alert: HighFanout429Burst
  expr: increase(model_serving_errors_total{status="429"}[5m]) > 100
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "Transient 429 burst on model-serving-rt"
```

leah_sre: good. changed severity to warning during burst is exactly what we want. can we also add a small runbook note to link to rollback?

anya_eng: added runbook link to the alert annotation and committed.

sam_oncall: PD squelch + router dedupe + prom rule change are live. initial alert flood dropped by ~78% in the last 5m. monitoring shows tail latency climbing but not customer 5xxs.

mike_support: customer comms ready to send if needed. waiting to see if we need to escalate to product.

nora_prodops: i'm watching capacity graphs. GPUs are at 82% — previously were spiking to 95%. autoscaler seems to be catching up. we'll keep the squelch for the 15m and reassess.

leah_sre: action item: after stabilization, we should do a follow-up to implement persistent grouping by error signature and add a per-service rate-limit on alerts in the router. I can own the RFC.

sam_oncall: agree. also want a new dashboard tile for "unique error signatures per minute" so alerts reflect unique failures, not retries. anya, can you add the dashboard panel?

anya_eng: on it. creating panel in opsdash -> queries to count label_replace(error_signature) per minute. will link in thread when done.

infra-bot: dashboard "model-serving-rt incident watch" created: https://ops.example.com/d/abcd1234/model-serving-rt-incident-watch

sam_oncall: closing PD maintenance window now (we'll keep dedupe policy for another 10m). please keep an eye and post if things regress.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: maintenance window ended for service=model-serving-rt.

leah_sre: post-mortem items (assign):
- anya: persist dedupe policy design + dashboard tile (due EOD)
- leah: RFC for router-level rate limits and grouping (due 3 business days)
- nora: autoscaler tuning notes + cost impact (due 2 business days)
- sam: incident timeline and PD/runbook updates (due EOD)

mike_support: i'll follow up with customers who pinged us. note: two customers asked for ETA; they were given an initial "we're stabilizing the service" message.

anya_eng: quick note on root cause: a burst of background batch jobs retried aggressively after a transient S3 error, causing hundreds of near-simultaneous inference requests. we'll add jitter to retry logic and try to spread fanout windows.

sam_oncall: thanks everyone. marking thread resolved for oncall — will reopen if alerts spike back up. :white_check_mark:
